name: voyager-1
lightTimeNote: Approximate Earth-to-Voyager 1 light time for late October 2026 (about 172 AU); NASA expects it to pass one light-day in November 2026.
ratesNote: Voyager 1 science downlink 160 bps, command uplink 16 bps.
overheadNote: Estimated BPv7 primary + payload block headers per bundle. The Merkle leaf and branch carried in each bundle are counted from the real bundle.
tracksNote: Illustrative 70 m DSN schedule, not the real one: one 8-hour track a day at 06:00-14:00 UTC, with day 2 missed (antenna maintenance).
